```{python}
#| label: start-spark

import sparknlp
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark: SparkSession = sparknlp.start()
```

```{python}
#| label: cache-files

import pathlib
cache_dir = pathlib.Path("cache")
cache_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

books_cache = cache_dir / "books.parquet"
annotation_cache = cache_dir / "annotation.parquet"

dl_books = not books_cache.exists() and not annotation_cache.exists()
do_annotation = not annotation_cache.exists()
```

```{python}
#| label: download

from gutenbergpy.textget import get_text_by_id, strip_headers
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import ArrayType, StringType

@F.udf(ArrayType(StringType()))
def download_book(id):
    raw = get_text_by_id(id)
    text = strip_headers(raw).decode("utf-8").split("\n\n")
    return [p.strip() for p in text if p.strip() != ""]

if dl_books:
    books = (
        spark.read.csv(
            "books.csv",
            header=True,
            schema="author STRING, type STRING, title STRING, id INT"
        )
        .withColumn("text", download_book("id"))
        .select("*", F.explode("text").alias("paragraph"))
        .drop("text")
    )
    books.write.parquet(str(books_cache))
elif do_annotation:
    books = spark.read.parquet(str(books_cache))
```
